Question: In our family 8 members are there. one mother 2 daughter and 5 sons.Valuation of the property is 1 crores. please divides this property in the above 8 member as per the Islamic law. How much amount will each member will receives. Please explain. Answer ID: 16745 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1666/1329/L=1430) In the abovementioned case, the one crore rupees will be distributed as follows: 1250000 to his wife (your mother), 1458333 to each of the five sons and 729166 to each of the two daughters. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
